summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing the closing of a registered direct offering of 66,666,667 ordinary shares for gross proceeds of approximately $30 million, with proceeds for general corporate purposes including commercialization of its Perciz security brand. The offering was made under an existing F-3 shelf registration statement and a prospectus supplement dated July 28, 2026; legal opinion by Naschitz, Brandes, Amir & Co. was filed as an exhibit. The filing is a routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special-situation transaction, and involves no change of control, repurchase, or strategic event. No deal terms typically associated with special situations were provided.
